rules.overdue: status OPEN and due_current before today
rules.corrected: corrected odds = raw odds_now minus the mean signed error of the event's active judgment tags, held between 1 and 99. odds_now is never overwritten; the raw number keeps getting scored.

tag_meanings.timing: did a dated step arrive when the graph said
tag_meanings.brakes: did someone step in to stop or soften it (rescue, extension, waiver, backstop)
tag_meanings.actor: did a government or company do the dramatic thing or the routine thing
tag_meanings.market: Earth2's odds differ from a recorded market number; who was right
tag_meanings.pace: did it arrive sooner or larger than the recorded consensus

pace.rule: share of settled pace questions answered YES; write a pace question so YES means sooner or larger than the consensus
